cards.title: IVIVE Binding Assumptions Impact Accuracy
cards.claim: IVIVE methods using microsomes incorporating both plasma and microsomal binding, and hepatocytes not incorporating binding, achieved ~75-78% predictions within twofold error. Other binding assumption combinations were much less accurate.
conditions: Use when IVIVE is selected over allometry
Requires accurate measurement of plasma and microsomal binding fractions
limitations: Abstract does not specify exact equations for 'fu intercept method' or specific binding correction formulas
Generalizability to new compounds not guaranteed
cards.downstream_use: Guiding selection of binding correction strategy in IVIVE models

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
